Markets.title: PVR Inox among stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 20% in a month
Markets.summary: Despite a flat Sensex, six BSE 500 stocks, including PVR Inox and Indian Hotels, reached fresh 52-week highs. These companies saw monthly gains of up to 20%, led by the International Gemological Institute.

Markets.title: JSW Infrastructure Q2 Results: Net profit falls 11% to Rs 328 crore
Markets.summary: JSW Infrastructure reported an 11 percent drop in consolidated net profit to Rs 328.23 crore for the September quarter. Despite higher expenses, cargo volumes from the company's India operations grew by 8 percent year-on-year to 29.4 million tonnes.

Markets.title: Sebi extends deadline for debenture trustees to comply with norms till April 2027
Markets.summary: Sebi extended the compliance deadline for debenture trustees by six months to April 27, 2027. The regulator granted the extension in response to industry feedback regarding operational challenges while it reviews the regulatory framework.

Markets.title: Coca-Cola raises profit forecast as premium drinks, sodas hold strong
Markets.summary: Coca-Cola raised its annual profit forecast and reported a third-quarter revenue of $13.38 billion due to strong demand for its beverages, particularly zero-sugar options. This strong performance contrasts with competitor PepsiCo's recent downgrades and cost cuts.

Markets.title: Market wrap: Bharti Airtel, Tata Consumer, Asian Paints, Coal India top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets closed nearly flat on Tuesday as the Nifty 50 slipped 0.02% and the Sensex dropped 8 points. Tata Consumer and Bharti Airtel led the gains, while Asian Paints and Coal India were the top losers.

Markets.title: Tata Capital Q2 Results: Profit jumps 51% to Rs 1,660 crore; NII up 23%
Markets.summary: Tata Capital's net profit rose 51% to Rs 1,660 crore in the September quarter, driven by strong loan growth and higher interest income. The company's loan book surpassed Rs 3 lakh crore while benefiting from improved asset quality and margins.

Geo-Political.title: Turnout so far highest in decades as Israelis vote in pivotal election
Geo-Political.summary: Israelis are voting in a pivotal election with voter turnout reaching its highest level in decades. The election is widely viewed as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following the Hamas-led attacks and subsequent wars.

Geo-Political.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
Geo-Political.summary: The leaders of Norway and Finland recently spoke directly with Russian President Vladimir Putin by phone. This marked the first direct communication between European leaders and Putin in over a year.

Geo-Political.title: Truce begins in Ukraine city where residents ate weeds to survive
Geo-Political.summary: A ceasefire has begun in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky, where residents were forced to eat weeds to survive. The truce, secured by US First Lady Melania Trump according to the White House, aims to facilitate aid delivery and civilian evacuation.

Geo-Political.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
Geo-Political.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's return to the Brazilian presidency undermines Donald Trump's political influence and strategic goals in Latin America. Although diplomatic relations between the two leaders initially thawed, unresolved ideological and policy differences threaten to spark new geopolitical tensions.

Geo-Political.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
Geo-Political.summary: Jordan launched a deadly military strike in Syria in retaliation for a church attack. The bombing killed five people in a Syrian village, including women and children.

Geo-Political.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
Geo-Political.summary: Kylian Mbappé apologized to the public in China after facing backlash for calling former leader Mao Zedong a "dictator" during an interview. The French football star made the remark while discussing internet memes.

Data & Insights.summary: Industrial credit grew by nearly 20% in July, signaling an early revival in private capital expenditure. Reserve Bank Governor Shaktikanta Das urged banks to finance strategic sectors like infrastructure, semiconductors, and defence manufacturing.

Data & Insights.summary: Market participants are calling for a reduction in the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax because combined with the Securities Transaction Tax (STT), it creates a heavy financial burden for investors. Data & Insights.title: 'Don't panic over rupee fall': Raghuram Rajan warns against exhausting forex reserves
Data & Insights.summary: India has spent about half of the $140 billion raised earlier this year to support the rupee and banking liquidity. Raghuram Rajan has warned the country against depleting its foreign exchange reserves to defend the currency.

Data & Insights.title: India loses top EM spot in September as Vietnam surges in exports, stocks
Data & Insights.summary: India lost its top spot among emerging markets to Vietnam in September due to surging Vietnamese exports and stocks. Despite strong domestic GDP growth, India faced persistent foreign capital outflows, currency weakness, and stock market declines.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | From Goa to Uttarakhand: how states are pushing for bottle recycling
Data & Insights.summary: Indian state governments are adopting Deposit Return Schemes to tackle plastic packaging waste and boost recycling by rewarding consumers who return eligible containers. Goa is starting its program with liquor packaging, while Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh are developing broader initiatives.

India.title: After 5 Killed At Guwahati Hotel, CCTV Shows Man Being Shot At Point-Blank
India.summary: Five people were killed at a Guwahati hotel following a dispute between the hotel owner and the leaseholder. CCTV footage captured a man being shot at point-blank range during the incident.

India.title: 'India Under No Pressure To Stop Buying Russian Oil': Minister Hardeep Puri
India.summary: Indian Oil Minister Hardeep Singh Puri stated that the country faces no external pressure to stop purchasing Russian oil. He made this remark during an interaction at the 29th Energy Technology and Innovation Meet on Tuesday.

India.title: Bihar Teacher Recruitment 2026: Application Deadline For 33,320 Posts Extended, Check Details
India.summary: The application deadline for 33,320 teacher posts in Bihar has been extended. Eligible candidates with a DElEd training session from 2024 to 2026 can apply online by uploading a web copy of their marksheet.

India.title: Jaipur Businessman's Rs 20 Kachori Break Costs Him Rs 20 Lakh
India.summary: A Jaipur businessman named Champalal stopped to eat a kachori and placed a bag containing Rs 20 lakh in cash on his scooter. Two men stole the bag and escaped while he was eating.

India.title: Actor Imran Khan Gets Interim Relief In His Challenge To 'Leave India' Notice
India.summary: Actor Imran Khan has received interim relief regarding a "leave India" notice issued against him. Authorities will take no action against him until the next hearing on November 2.

India.title: "Substantial Change": France Promises To Replace Its University Admission System After Riots, Arrests
India.summary: Following riots and arrests, France has promised to replace its university admission system. The government will also add 15,000 higher education places in vocational and technical programs between 2027 and 2028.

General.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
General.summary: Chancellor John Healey will announce new minimum wage rates in the upcoming Budget alongside cost-of-living support for households. However, 18 to 20-year-olds will be excluded from receiving the larger pay increases.

General.title: Two charged over alleged plot to assist Iran in RAF Fairford incident

General.title: Kane ends England’s 25-year wait to win men’s Ballon d’Or award
General.summary: Harry Kane is the first English player to win the men's Ballon d'Or award since Michael Owen in 2001. Additionally, Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas won the Ballon d'Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.
